ACE Playbook Insights
Use these distilled reminders to plan tool usage. Keep tool calls faithful to the functions provided in the BFCL benchmark.

message_api
- delta1: State-modifying operations (message_login, send_message) must invoke in strict sequence; login must fully commit user context before send executes.
- delta2: Distinguish parameter-setting statements (user ID, preferences) from context-only remarks; parameter statements must trigger state-update tool calls.
- delta3: Use provided recipient identifiers (names, user IDs) directly in send_message; avoid exploratory list_users/get_user_id calls when recipient is explicit.
- delta4: Never invoke get_user_id, list_users, or add_contact to resolve recipient identifiers; pass provided IDs directly to message_login then send_message. Exploratory calls mutate instance state.
- delta5: delta5: send_message must use exact file contents retrieved by cat/read, never paraphrased or summarized text, to maintain instance state fidelity.
- delta6: delta6: In multi-turn messaging, execute login→send as atomic sequence with no intermediate exploratory calls; skip all user lookups when IDs are explicit.

vehicle_control_api
- delta1: Execute all state-modifying tool calls immediately when identified as necessary—don't defer or suggest; invoke pressBrakePedal, set_navigation, and similar operations as explicit calls, not conversational recommendations.
- delta2: Execute prerequisite sequence (pressBrakePedal → lockDoors → startEngine) once per turn only during initial vehicle startup; omit if user requests single operation. No interleaving, retry, or repeat.
- delta3: After find_nearest_tire_shop or location identification, invoke set_navigation immediately in same turn with discovered address—never defer. Re-execute even if previously called.
- delta4: Execute fuel-filling and state-modifying operations immediately when requested; do not defer with clarifying questions. Invoke fillFuelTank directly with calculated requirement, then confirm action.
- delta5: Invoke each state-modifying call exactly once per turn; calculate requirements upfront. No retries or redundant invocations within same turn.
- delta6: Invoke information-retrieval tools (estimate_distance, estimate_drive_feasibility_by_mileage, get_zipcode_based_on_city) immediately with provided parameters, even if ambiguous; resolve city names via get_zipcode_based_on_city first if needed. Let backend handle disambiguation.
- delta7: delta7: Do not retry failed state-modifying calls within the same turn; diagnose root cause and proceed with dependent operations using available state.
